messages.author: 056a0f54645c6009
messages.subject: Eeee Deducer killed  by new R 3.X install
parts:
Hi all,

Well poop. Seems every time I install a new version of R like the
current 3.x Deducer and JGR stop working.

Last time many months back I had to uninstall the current version of R
and resinstall Deducer from scratch then copy all my libraries over
again to the new installation.

Had to do this as a new R package I need to use tlocoh_1.13 was built
under R3 and will not run under eh older 2.15 versions.

Ian any way to stop new versions of R from killing off Deducer and JGR?

Bruce

messages.author: 056a0f54645c6009
messages.subject: Deducer Now OK  with new R 3.X install
parts:
Hi all,

OK deleted ALL R versions form my system and then installed only R3.02
(32 & 64 bit).

Used the
install.packages(c("JGR","Deducer","DeducerExtras"))
library(JGR)
JGR()

and the shortcut on my desktop worked again.

Copied all Libraries I had to the new R 3.02 except newest ones
installed with R. and all seems to be working.

Seems the only way to update the base R is to delete everything
(uninstall) then add newest one back in then re-install Deducer.

Sorry for the temp hissy fit
:-0
Bruce
